basis: calibration.json: seven normal-motion desktop scenarios, 14–168 strokes, including an 84.3s long task; retain headroom and verify separately at the stroke-count boundary
scope: Windows desktop, 1440x900, DPR2, local glyphs, current Chrome with SwiftShader permitted; not a universal device claim
activeLeasePolicy: Active references stay pinned and may exceed retained-cache budgets; task stroke and time limits bound work. Release must restore both caches to budget.

adaptive.trigger: 30 consecutive measured render intervals averaging over 30ms
